source.other: Jundlina decides

target.other: Jundlina beslutar

key: Jundlina decides

source.other: We need some spidercloth urgently as we are running out of it. It is therefore essential to spare every piece we still have. Reduce the input of all buildings that consume spidercloth, not forgetting the construction sites.

target.other: Vi behöver omgående spindeltyg eftersom det börjar ta slut. Det är därför absolut nödvändigt att spara varenda bit vi fortfarande har. Minska tillförseln till alla byggnader som konsumerar spindeltyg och glöm inte byggarbetsplatserna.

key: We need some spidercloth urgently as we are running out of it. It is therefore essential to spare every piece we still have. Reduce the input of all buildings that consume spidercloth, not forgetting the construction sites.

source.other: Priestesses are needed to make Satul show his might.

target.other: Prästinnor behövs för att Satul ska kunna visa sin mäktighet.

key: Priestesses are needed to make Satul show his might.

source.other: Trading Post Built

target.other: Handelsstation byggd

key: Trading Post Built

source.other: Make New Tools

target.other: Gör nya verktyg

key: Make New Tools

target.other: Hyllning framförd

key: Tribute Delivered

source.other: Sidolus

target.other: Sidolus

developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: To be used in placeholders for switching texts according to current leader
key: Sidolus

source.other: New Hope

target.other: Nytt hopp

key: New Hope

source.other: Aaaargh, Jundlina. I don’t know how this could have happened, but Satul couldn’t protect us from the enemy. They have destroyed our last warehouse. Thus we have lost this battle and our people is doomed!

target.other: Aaaargh, Jundlina. Jag vet inte hur detta kunde hända, men Satul kunde inte skydda oss från fienden. De har förstört vår sista lagerbyggnad. Därmed har vi förlorat denna strid och vårt folk är dömt!

key: Aaaargh, Jundlina. I don’t know how this could have happened, but Satul couldn’t protect us from the enemy. They have destroyed our last warehouse. Thus we have lost this battle and our people is doomed!

source.other: However, we need to take care of our building materials: The island is full of trees, we might not even need foresters. But we need stone, that much is certain!

target.other: Vi måste dock ta hand om våra byggmaterial: Ön är full av träd, vi kanske inte ens behöver skogsvårdare. Men vi behöver sten, så mycket är säkert!

key: However, we need to take care of our building materials: The island is full of trees, we might not even need foresters. But we need stone, that much is certain!

source.other: A trader is a scout who needs a horse to transport the wares.

target.other: En handelsman är en spanare som behöver en häst för transporten av varor.

key: A trader is a scout who needs a horse to transport the wares.

source.other: Build a temple to worship Satul

target.other: Bygg ett tempel för att dyrka Satul

key: Build a temple to worship Satul

source.other: Heretics!

target.other: Kättare!

key: Heretics!

source.other: Mining Established

target.other: Gruvdrift etablerad

key: Mining Established

source.other: Building Material Ensured

target.other: Byggmaterial säkrat

key: Building Material Ensured

source.other: %s Acknowledges

target.other: %s bekräftar

developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: placeholder is the name of the current leader (either Jundlina or Sidolus)
key: %s Acknowledges

source.other: But we need to be cautious using the stones and other precious material. When we no longer need a building, we will dismantle it instead of burning it down.

target.other: Men vi måste vara försiktiga när vi använder stenar och andra värdefulla material. När vi inte längre behöver en byggnad ska vi riva den istället för att bränna ner den.

key: But we need to be cautious using the stones and other precious material. When we no longer need a building, we will dismantle it instead of burning it down.

source.other: Sidolus Agrees

target.other: Sidolus instämmer

key: Sidolus Agrees

source.other: May Satul warm you, Sidolus! My builders just completed the temple for Satul. Now we can start worshipping him and consecrating our priestesses.

target.other: Må Satul värma dig, Sidolus! Mina byggare har just färdigställt Satuls tempel. Nu kan vi börja dyrka honom och inviga våra prästinnor.

key: May Satul warm you, Sidolus! My builders just completed the temple for Satul. Now we can start worshipping him and consecrating our priestesses.

source.other: Upgrade Scout’s House To Trading Post

target.other: Uppgradera spanarstugan till handelsplats

key: Upgrade Scout’s House To Trading Post

source.other: Afterwards we need to construct a farm under all circumstances, as it needs spidercloth to be built. Additionally, we need a spider farm and a weaving mill.

target.other: Under alla omständigheter måste vi därefter bygga en majsodling, då den behöver spindeltyg för att byggas. Dessutom behöver vi en spindelodling och ett väveri.

key: Afterwards we need to construct a farm under all circumstances, as it needs spidercloth to be built. Additionally, we need a spider farm and a weaving mill.

source.other: Now it’s time to finish off this annoying Barbarian. He has molested us far too long now.

target.other: Nu är det dags att göra slut på den här irriterande barbaren. Han har trakasserat oss alldeles för länge nu.

key: Now it’s time to finish off this annoying Barbarian. He has molested us far too long now.

source.other: Worships Satul.

target.other: Dyrkar Satul.

developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Purpose helptext for an Atlantean worker: Priestess
key: Worships Satul.

source.other: Sidolus, this is very good news. I appreciate what your people has done. However don’t forget to help us defeat the troops of Maletus. Afterwards we might talk about your princess.

target.other: Sidolus, det här är mycket goda nyheter. Jag uppskattar vad ditt folk har gjort. Glöm dock inte att hjälpa oss att besegra Maletus trupper. Efteråt kan vi prata om er prinsessa.

key: Sidolus, this is very good news. I appreciate what your people has done. However don’t forget to help us defeat the troops of Maletus. Afterwards we might talk about your princess.

source.other: Praise Satul, we have founded a new home. I deeply regret I was weak in my belief. May Satul guide me better in the future.

target.other: Prisa Satul, vi har grundat ett nytt hem. Jag ångrar djupt att jag var svag i min tro. Må Satul vägleda mig bättre i framtiden.

key: Praise Satul, we have founded a new home. I deeply regret I was weak in my belief. May Satul guide me better in the future.

source.other: Jundlina Is Concerned

target.other: Jundlina är bekymrad

key: Jundlina Is Concerned

source.other: However, our enemy in the North is very strong. I am afraid that without significant help from your side we might lose the war despite any help in terms of wares you might provide.

target.other: Men vår fiende i norr är mycket stark. Jag är rädd att vi utan betydande hjälp från er sida kan förlora kriget, trots all hjälp i form av varor som ni kan ge oss.

key: However, our enemy in the North is very strong. I am afraid that without significant help from your side we might lose the war despite any help in terms of wares you might provide.

source.other: Trader

target.other: Handlare

developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: This is a worker name used in lists of workers
key: Trader

source.other: %s Enchanted

target.other: %s förtrollad

developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: placeholder is the name of the current leader (either Jundlina or Sidolus)
key: %s Enchanted

source.other: All of us were fiercely afraid. We expected the other ships to be sunken as well, but they persisted. We escaped the island and began our smooth sailing to other coasts.

target.other: Vi var alla dödsrädda. Vi trodde att de andra skeppen också skulle sjunka, men de höll sig flytande. Vi flydde från ön och fortsatte vår lugna seglats mot andra kuster.

key: All of us were fiercely afraid. We expected the other ships to be sunken as well, but they persisted. We escaped the island and began our smooth sailing to other coasts.

source.other: Kalitath Acknowledges

target.other: Kalitath bekräftar

key: Kalitath Acknowledges

source.other: This is good news indeed, Opol. You may go back to your work now, and may Satul warm you and the weavers’ guild!

target.other: Det är verkligen goda nyheter, Opol. Du kan återgå till ditt arbete nu, och må Satul värma dig och vävarnas skrå!

developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: either Jundlina or Sidolus depending who is in charge
key: This is good news indeed, Opol. You may go back to your work now, and may Satul warm you and the weavers’ guild!

source.other: Be Vigilant!

target.other: Var vaksam!

key: Be Vigilant!

source.other: We have not much water left; our food is running low; we lost all our tools and most of our building materials with the third ship. We can’t afford to sail any further, and we must attempt to settle on this island as close as possible to our current position.

target.other: Vi har inte mycket vatten kvar, maten börjar ta slut och vi förlorade alla våra verktyg och det mesta av vårt byggmaterial med det tredje skeppet. Vi har inte råd att segla längre och måste försöka bosätta oss på denna ö så nära vår nuvarande position som möjligt.

key: We have not much water left; our food is running low; we lost all our tools and most of our building materials with the third ship. We can’t afford to sail any further, and we must attempt to settle on this island as close as possible to our current position.

source.other: %s, may Satul warm you! Another issue solved. We have found some resources and built a mine of each type.

target.other: %s, må Satul värma dig! Ännu ett problem löst. Vi har hittat några resurser och byggt en gruva av varje typ.

developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Loftomor (placeholder is the name of the current leader)
key: %s, may Satul warm you! Another issue solved. We have found some resources and built a mine of each type.

source.other: Kalitath Appreciates Efforts

target.other: Kalitath uppskattar insatsen

key: Kalitath Appreciates Efforts

source.other: Temple Completed

target.other: Templet färdigställt

key: Temple Completed

source.other: They name themselves an Empire, and their leader is called Maletus. I want you to train your soldiers and help us defeat his lousy Empire.

target.other: De kallar sig själva för ett imperium, och deras ledare heter Maletus. Jag vill att du tränar dina soldater och hjälper oss att besegra hans usla imperium.

key: They name themselves an Empire, and their leader is called Maletus. I want you to train your soldiers and help us defeat his lousy Empire.

source.other: As we are facing great losses due to your laziness, you shall now send us twice the previous amount of each ware.

target.other: Eftersom vi lider stora förluster på grund av din lathet, ska du nu skicka oss dubbelt så mycket av varje vara som tidigare.

key: As we are facing great losses due to your laziness, you shall now send us twice the previous amount of each ware.

source.other: May Satul warm us all. Our princess has been confused in her imprisonment by this Barbarian. But I will never worship any Barbarian god. I can’t imagine how we could change her mind though.

target.other: Må Satul värma oss alla. Vår prinsessa har blivit förvirrad under sin fångenskap hos denna barbar. Men jag kommer aldrig att dyrka någon barbarisk gud. Jag kan dock inte föreställa mig hur vi skulle kunna få henne att ändra sig.

key: May Satul warm us all. Our princess has been confused in her imprisonment by this Barbarian. But I will never worship any Barbarian god. I can’t imagine how we could change her mind though.

source.other: %s! It seems there is another problem even more urgent. I fear we haven’t built a farm to feed our spiders yet. As this is one of the buildings needing spidercloth for completion, not completing one in time will result in a crisis that can never be resolved.

target.other: %s! Det verkar finnas ett annat problem som är ännu mer brådskande. Jag är rädd att vi ännu inte har byggt en gård för att mata våra spindlar. Eftersom detta är en av de byggnader som behöver spindeltyg för att kunna färdigställas, kommer det att leda till en kris som aldrig kan lösas om vi inte hinner färdigställa den i tid.

developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Opol (placeholder is the name of the current leader)
key: %s! It seems there is another problem even more urgent. I fear we haven’t built a farm to feed our spiders yet. As this is one of the buildings needing spidercloth for completion, not completing one in time will result in a crisis that can never be resolved.

source.other: First you need to upgrade our scout’s house to a trading post. Then you need to send the demanded tributes of gold, iron, coal, and logs.

target.other: Först måste du uppgradera våran spanarstuga till en handelsplats. Sedan måste du skicka den förväntade hyllningen innehållande guld, järn, kol och stockar.

key: First you need to upgrade our scout’s house to a trading post. Then you need to send the demanded tributes of gold, iron, coal, and logs.

source.other: Keep Delivering

target.other: Fortsätt leverera

key: Keep Delivering

source.other: May Satul warm you, Jundlina! This behaviour is truly barbaric! I fear this is a trap to keep you as a hostage. And the demand itself is really an insult. I strongly recommend to decline this unsubstantiated claim.

target.other: Må Satul värma dig, Jundlina! Detta beteende är verkligen barbariskt! Jag fruktar att detta är en fälla för att hålla dig som gisslan. Och kravet i sig är verkligen en förolämpning. Jag rekommenderar starkt att du avvisar detta ogrundade krav.

key: May Satul warm you, Jundlina! This behaviour is truly barbaric! I fear this is a trap to keep you as a hostage. And the demand itself is really an insult. I strongly recommend to decline this unsubstantiated claim.

source.other: Three batches of three iron bars each.

target.other: Tre sändningar med tre järnstänger vardera.

key: Three batches of three iron bars each.

source.other: Initiates take care of the Temple of Satul while they are learning to become priestesses.

target.other: Initiaterna tar hand om Satuls tempel medan de lär sig att bli prästinnor.

key: Initiates take care of the Temple of Satul while they are learning to become priestesses.

source.other: Defeat Imperial Leader Maletus

target.other: Besegra den kejserlige ledaren Maletus

key: Defeat Imperial Leader Maletus

source.other: Sidolus, they did not let me go. I met our scout and he managed to sneak me out, as I realized they still kept me hostage after I expressed some concerns about our previous agreement. So we need to settle the Barbarian issue now and forever on this island. There is no other way to live here in peace than to defeat them.

target.other: Sidolus, de lät mig inte gå. Jag träffade vår spejare och han lyckades smuggla ut mig, eftersom jag insåg att de fortfarande höll mig som gisslan efter att jag uttryckt vissa farhågor om vårt tidigare avtal. Så vi måste lösa barbarfrågan nu och för alltid på denna ö. Det finns inget annat sätt att leva här i fred än att besegra dem.

key: Sidolus, they did not let me go. I met our scout and he managed to sneak me out, as I realized they still kept me hostage after I expressed some concerns about our previous agreement. So we need to settle the Barbarian issue now and forever on this island. There is no other way to live here in peace than to defeat them.

source.other: Well done, Loftomor, well done. May Satul warm our strong and brave miners. But now we need to ensure we can feed them. We need to build up bakeries and smokeries and all buildings to supply them.

target.other: Bra gjort, Loftomor, bra gjort. Må Satul värma våra starka och modiga gruvarbetare. Men nu måste vi se till att vi kan ge dem mat. Vi måste bygga bagerier, rökerier och alla byggnader som behövs för att försörja dem.

developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: either Jundlina or Sidolus depending who is in charge
key: Well done, Loftomor, well done. May Satul warm our strong and brave miners. But now we need to ensure we can feed them. We need to build up bakeries and smokeries and all buildings to supply them.

source.other: To be able to pay the tributes to Kalitath, and to maintain contact with Jundlina, we need to enhance our scout’s house to a trading post.

target.other: För att kunna betala tributerna till Kalitath och behålla kontakten med Jundlina måste vi bygga ut vår spanarstuga till en handelsplats.

key: To be able to pay the tributes to Kalitath, and to maintain contact with Jundlina, we need to enhance our scout’s house to a trading post.

source.other: The following batches need to be delivered:

target.other: Följande sändningar måste levereras:

key: The following batches need to be delivered:

source.other: Five batches of five logs each.

target.other: Fem sändningar med fem stockar vardera.

key: Five batches of five logs each.

source.other: We need to build a temple for Satul and we need to worship him well. By this he might show these Barbarians his might and our princess might come back to her senses.

target.other: Vi måste bygga ett tempel för Satul och vi måste dyrka honom väl. På så sätt kanske han visar dessa barbarer sin makt och vår prinsessa kanske återfår sitt förnuft.

key: We need to build a temple for Satul and we need to worship him well. By this he might show these Barbarians his might and our princess might come back to her senses.

source.other: Expand your territory

target.other: Utvidga ditt territorium

key: Expand your territory

source.other: Gold Coin

target.other: Guldmynt

developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: This is a ware name used in lists of wares
key: Gold Coin

source.other: May Satul warm you, Jundlina! We have made contact with the foreigners. They are in big trouble as they are at war with a mighty tribe in the north. They ask us for support.

target.other: Må Satul värma dig, Jundlina! Vi har tagit kontakt med utlänningarna. De är i stora svårigheter eftersom de befinner sig i krig med en mäktig stam i norr. De ber oss om hjälp.

key: May Satul warm you, Jundlina! We have made contact with the foreigners. They are in big trouble as they are at war with a mighty tribe in the north. They ask us for support.

source.other: %s Replies

target.other: %s svar

developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: placeholder is the name of the current leader (either Jundlina or Sidolus)
key: %s Replies

source.other: Find Portspace

target.other: Hitta hamnplats

key: Find Portspace

source.other: Build Temple For Satul

target.other: Bygg ett tempel för Satul

key: Build Temple For Satul

source.other: If you fail to deliver everything within three and a half hours, we need to assume you are just playing along with us. So keep an eye on the time as we will not give any further warning.

target.other: Om du inte levererar allt inom tre och en halv timme måste vi anta att du bara leker med oss. Håll därför koll på tiden, eftersom vi inte kommer att ge några ytterligare varningar.

key: If you fail to deliver everything within three and a half hours, we need to assume you are just playing along with us. So keep an eye on the time as we will not give any further warning.

source.other: Defeat Maletus

target.other: Besegra Maletus

key: Defeat Maletus

source.other: Jundlina writes her diary

target.other: Jundlina skriver sin dagbok

key: Jundlina writes her diary

source.other: Sidolus has bad news…

target.other: Sidolus har dåliga nyheter…

key: Sidolus has bad news…

source.other: This will take more time, but we can reuse some of its materials. Also, I want a scout deployed and exploring at all times.

target.other: Detta kommer att ta längre tid men vi kan återanvända en del av dess material. Jag vill också att en spanare anställs, som hela tiden utforskar.

key: This will take more time, but we can reuse some of its materials. Also, I want a scout deployed and exploring at all times.

source.other: Jundlina Explains

target.other: Jundlina förklarar

key: Jundlina Explains

source.other: Scout’s House

target.other: Spanarstuga

developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: This is a building name used in lists of buildings
key: Scout’s House

source.other: And one failed the test: the last days of loading was done in chaos and without much planning and so one of our ships ended up carrying most of the heavy wares in our possession.

target.other: Och en misslyckades med testet: de sista dagarna av lastningen genomfördes i kaos och utan mycket planering, vilket ledde till att ett av våra fartyg fick transportera större delen av de tunga varorna i vår ägo.

key: And one failed the test: the last days of loading was done in chaos and without much planning and so one of our ships ended up carrying most of the heavy wares in our possession.

source.other: This is good news indeed, Loftomor. This enables us to operate all the buildings we are going to build in our new home. But now we should really look to get some resources from the mountains.

target.other: Det är verkligen goda nyheter, Loftomor. Det gör att vi kan driva alla byggnader som vi ska bygga i vårt nya hem. Men nu bör vi verkligen försöka skaffa resurser från bergen.

developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: either Jundlina or Sidolus depending who is in charge
key: This is good news indeed, Loftomor. This enables us to operate all the buildings we are going to build in our new home. But now we should really look to get some resources from the mountains.

source.other: Barbarian, I am an Atlantean princess and I will never go into slavery. I have prepared myself for this eventuality and will rather die from the poison I carry with me than be your slave. May Satul avenge my sacrifice.

target.other: Barbar, jag är en prinsessa från Atlantis och jag kommer aldrig att gå i slaveri. Jag har förberett mig för denna eventualitet och hellre dör av det gift jag bär med mig än blir din slav. Må Satul hämnas min uppoffring.

key: Barbarian, I am an Atlantean princess and I will never go into slavery. I have prepared myself for this eventuality and will rather die from the poison I carry with me than be your slave. May Satul avenge my sacrifice.

source.other: %s, may Satul warm you! The weaving mill and spider farm are complete and the weavers’ guild can start their work again. I promise we will deliver the finest cloth and some tabards soon. Maybe we can build a gold spinning mill later on to make better tabards as well.

target.other: %s, må Satul värma dig! Vävfabriken och spindelfarmen är färdiga och vävarnas skrå kan återuppta sitt arbete. Jag lovar att vi snart kommer att leverera de finaste tygerna och några tabarder. Kanske kan vi bygga ett guldspinnverk senare för att tillverka ännu bättre tabarder.

developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Opol (placeholder is the name of the current leader)
key: %s, may Satul warm you! The weaving mill and spider farm are complete and the weavers’ guild can start their work again. I promise we will deliver the finest cloth and some tabards soon. Maybe we can build a gold spinning mill later on to make better tabards as well.

source.other: Most of our tools have been lost in the ship tragedy. Our people will not be able to fulfill their duties without proper tools. Luckily we still have some iron ore and plenty of coal. Build a toolsmithy, as it is a prerequisite for success on the island. Don’t forget to build a smelting works as well.

target.other: De flesta av våra verktyg har förlorats i skeppstragedin. Vårt folk kommer inte kunna fullfölja sina uppgifter utan ordentliga verktyg. Som tur är har vi fortfarande en del järnmalm och gott om kol. Bygg en verktygssmedja eftersom det är en förutsättning för att lyckas på ön. Glöm inte att också bygga ett smältverk.

key: Most of our tools have been lost in the ship tragedy. Our people will not be able to fulfill their duties without proper tools. Luckily we still have some iron ore and plenty of coal. Build a toolsmithy, as it is a prerequisite for success on the island. Don’t forget to build a smelting works as well.

source.other: Let’s also explore this island and expand our territory. But we need to be careful. We should build at least one tower so that we can see potential enemies before they see us.

target.other: Låt oss också utforska denna ö och utvidga vårt territorium. Men vi måste vara försiktiga. Vi bör bygga minst ett torn så att vi kan se potentiella fiender innan de ser oss.

key: Let’s also explore this island and expand our territory. But we need to be careful. We should build at least one tower so that we can see potential enemies before they see us.

source.other: Now it is time to celebrate but I expect we can’t relax long. We need to build up our society and our capability to explore the seas again.

target.other: Nu är det dags att fira, men jag tror inte att vi kan slappna av så länge. Vi måste bygga upp vårt samhälle och vår förmåga att utforska haven igen.

key: Now it is time to celebrate but I expect we can’t relax long. We need to build up our society and our capability to explore the seas again.

source.other: Sidolus is very sad

target.other: Sidolus är mycket ledsen

key: Sidolus is very sad

source.other: Aaaargh. I don’t know how this could have happened, but Satul couldn’t protect us from the enemy. We have lost our noble princess. Thus, we have lost this battle and our people is doomed!

target.other: Aaaargh. Jag vet inte hur detta kunde hända, men Satul kunde inte skydda oss från fienden. Vi har förlorat vår ädla prinsessa. Därmed har vi förlorat denna strid och vårt folk är dömt!

key: Aaaargh. I don’t know how this could have happened, but Satul couldn’t protect us from the enemy. We have lost our noble princess. Thus, we have lost this battle and our people is doomed!

source.other: Planning For The Future

target.other: Planera för framtiden

key: Planning For The Future

source.other: Jundlina continues

target.other: Jundlina fortsätter

key: Jundlina continues

source.other: Transports wares to share with other players.

target.other: Transporterar varor för att dela med andra spelare.

developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Purpose helptext for an Atlantean worker: Trader
key: Transports wares to share with other players.

source.other: Opol Makes A Point

target.other: Opol gör en poäng

key: Opol Makes A Point

source.other: We are fairly sure that we are not alone on the island. We do not know if the others on this island are friends or foes, so we need to tread carefully. Explore the island by building at least one house for a scout.

target.other: Vi är ganska säkra på att vi inte är ensamma på ön. Vi vet inte om de andra på ön är vänner eller fiender, så vi måste gå varsamt fram. Utforska ön genom att bygga minst ett hus för en spanare.

key: We are fairly sure that we are not alone on the island. We do not know if the others on this island are friends or foes, so we need to tread carefully. Explore the island by building at least one house for a scout.

source.other: %s, may Satul warm you! We have made some progress in building up our tool industry.

target.other: %s, må Satul värma dig! Vi har gjort vissa framsteg när det gäller att bygga upp vår verktygsindustri.

developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: Loftomor (placeholder is the name of the current leader)
key: %s, may Satul warm you! We have made some progress in building up our tool industry.

source.other: Well done, Loftomor, well done. May Satul warm our princess and our whole people. Now we need to begin sending goods to this Barbarian.

source.other: May Satul warm you, Loftomor. This is a very good idea indeed. So I task you to build a temple worth worshipping our god. Until we are ready to beg for Satul’s power we should keep an eye on our princess and this Barbarian. As we should stop our trader’s deliveries to not waste any wares to this Barbarian any more, I want you to ensure we have a scout out there to gather information.

target.other: Må Satul värma dig, Loftomor. Detta är verkligen en bra idé, så jag ger dig uppdraget att bygga ett tempel som är värdigt vår gud. Fram tills vi är redo att be om Satuls styrka måste vi hålla ett öga på vår prinsessa och den här barbaren. Vi bör stoppa vår köpmans leveranser för att inte slösa fler varor på honom. Se till att vi har en spanare där ute som samlar information.

So we will simply take your military buildings with our forces. Naturally you won’t have the right to do the same, for the sake of your princess.

Då kommer vi helt enkelt att ta dina militära byggnader med våra styrkor. Naturligtvis har du inte rätt att göra detsamma, för din prinsessas skull.

source.other: May Satul warm you, Sidolus. And may he forgive me my heretic behaviour. The sign of his might and the fear in the Barbarians’ faces suddenly made me recognise the truth again. I was wrong about peace and coexistence, as it would have meant servitude forever. And this is not what Atlanteans are made for.

target.other: Må Satul värma dig, Sidolus. Och må han förlåta mig mitt kätterska beteende. Tecknet på hans makt och rädslan i barbarernas ansikten fick mig plötsligt att inse sanningen igen. Jag hade fel om fred och samexistens, eftersom det skulle ha inneburit evig träldom. Och det är inte vad atlanterna är skapta för.

key: May Satul warm you, Sidolus. And may he forgive me my heretic behaviour. The sign of his might and the fear in the Barbarians’ faces suddenly made me recognise the truth again. I was wrong about peace and coexistence, as it would have meant servitude forever. And this is not what Atlanteans are made for.

target.other: Främlingar, vi behöver få något tecken på era goda avsikter. Om ni verkligen står på vår sida bör ni skicka oss guld och några andra varor regelbundet.

source.other: The only thing we know for sure is that they cannot be Atlanteans, for no ship of ours has sailed as far as we did for centuries. I can only hope they are friendly.

target.other: Det enda vi vet med säkerhet är att de inte kan vara atlanter, eftersom inget av våra skepp har seglat så långt som vi gjorde på flera hundra år. Jag kan bara hoppas att de är vänligt sinnade.

key: The only thing we know for sure is that they cannot be Atlanteans, for no ship of ours has sailed as far as we did for centuries. I can only hope they are friendly.

source.other: Aaaargh. I don’t know how this could have happened, but Satul couldn’t protect our ally from the enemy. He lost his last warehouse and our noble princess perished with him. Thus, we have lost this battle and our people is doomed!

target.other: Aaaargh. Jag vet inte hur detta kunde hända, men Satul kunde inte skydda vår allierade från fienden. Han förlorade sitt sista magasin och vår ädla prinsessa omkom tillsammans med honom. Därmed har vi förlorat denna strid och vårt folk är dömt!

key: Aaaargh. I don’t know how this could have happened, but Satul couldn’t protect our ally from the enemy. He lost his last warehouse and our noble princess perished with him. Thus, we have lost this battle and our people is doomed!

target.other: Sidolus, jag håller med om att vi inte bör böja oss inför någon annan gud än Satul. Men i det här fallet kan vi behöva gudens hjälp. source.other: Sidolus, during my stay with the Barbarians I learned a lot about their hospitality and bravery. They really impressed me and their warriors and gods seemed to be very strong in the battle against the Empire. Especially their leader Kalitath made a very good host and I started to think about uniting our tribes to make for a peaceful future on this island. So I want you to prepare our people for a marriage and peaceful coexistence with the Barbarians. This includes learning about their gods and preparing to worship them.

target.other: Sidolus, under min vistelse hos barbarerna lärde jag mig mycket om deras gästfrihet och mod. De imponerade verkligen på mig och deras krigare och gudar verkade vara mycket starka i kampen mot imperiet. Särskilt deras ledare Kalitath var en mycket god värd och jag började fundera på att förena våra stammar för att skapa en fredlig framtid på denna ö. Därför vill jag att du förbereder vårt folk för ett äktenskap och en fredlig samexistens med barbarerna. Detta innefattar att lära sig om deras gudar och förbereda sig för att dyrka dem.

key: Sidolus, during my stay with the Barbarians I learned a lot about their hospitality and bravery. They really impressed me and their warriors and gods seemed to be very strong in the battle against the Empire. Especially their leader Kalitath made a very good host and I started to think about uniting our tribes to make for a peaceful future on this island. So I want you to prepare our people for a marriage and peaceful coexistence with the Barbarians. This includes learning about their gods and preparing to worship them.
